title: Roxie's Performance 121/086 Special Illustration Rare (SIR) Pokemon Chaos Rising
descriptionText: Roxie's Performance 121/086 Special Illustration Rare (SIR) Pokemon Chaos Rising is a highly sought-after trading card in the Pokémon franchise. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2026, this special card features Roxie, a unique character within the non-sport trading card realm. With its rare status and special illustration, this card is sure to be a valuable addition to any collector's deck.
